_correction_note: Original >=2-raw-hit threshold was a bug: it did not exclude puzzle n=1 (apply_puzzle_mask hardcodes masked=1 for any n<=1, so EVERY candidate trivially matches n=1) or account for n=2/n=3/n=4 matching by pure chance 50%/25%/12.5% of the time. All 371 originally-reported "confirmed" matches were this artifact, not real signal -- verified: 0/371 had 2+ hits at n>=20. Corrected here to require 2+ hits at n>=20 (chance rate <2e-6 per hit), matching the significance discipline used throughout the rest of this research program.
